comparison.objective: Raise a hanging photo and spring-clip its free corner to a wire; candidate separates a loose industrial mixture.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual support of a flexible sheet plus peg squeezing and precise clip placement versus rigid screen load sharing and controlled agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Second peg closes on wire and photo, photo level, released and still versus media recovery, washer retention, supported screen, hand clearance, and dwell.
comparison.reason: Flexible-sheet support and spring clipping are unrelated to selective rigid-body screening. Missing rubric details: none material.
